decisions.reason: Flanged dismantling joints build directly on the firm's pipeline-fitting, flange, and coating knowledge, allowing it to interpret early results and improve the product.

Although the firm has metal fabrication and coating capabilities, public waste bins fall outside its core water/wastewater infrastructure knowledge, limiting its ability to learn from early market feedback and improve the product.

Waste bins with ashtrays require additional product-specific knowledge about ashtray use, cleaning, and safety that the firm does not possess, further reducing its absorptive capacity to interpret results and enhance the product.

Outdoor public ashtrays are the most distant from the firm's existing pipeline and municipal water infrastructure knowledge, so the firm lacks the related knowledge to assess and improve this niche product.
